[[Asterius' Scythe]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[scythe]] dropped by [[Asterius the Mighty]], a [[boss]] in [[Varajar Fells]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 9-41 (Requires 9 [[Scythe Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Energy]] gain on hit: 1
:[[Energy]] regeneration: -1
:[[Enchantments]] last 20% longer
:Two-handed

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Briarwood Scythe]].

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Briarwood Scythe]] from collectors [[Fopp]] or [[Pathfinder Mia]] 
*[[Zealous]] [[Scythe Snathe]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Scythe Grip]] [[of Enchanting]]
